2. SCOPE OF WORK EXECUTED
Roads Highways works for Public Health Engineering Dept, Odisha completed 2020.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included existing services running across the
corridor that had to be protected in place. The agency organised its resources around this without
recourse to the department for additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to
keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of late availability of the client-supplied
cement consignment. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's
control; no compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the
approved drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been
completed in all respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending
Engineer.
3. QUALITY ASSESSMENT
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Satisfactory. Workmanship was satisfactory after
remedial work on the first pour, and final inspection was completed in the presence of the client's
representative. Materials were drawn from approved sources and the test results filed with this office
were within the limits prescribed in the contract specification.

5. DEFICIENCY / OBSERVATION LIST
At the time of taking over, no deficiency of consequence was recorded at handover. Regarding site
safety, no lost-time injury was reported over the contract period. The agency's conduct during the
contract is recorded as professional, though correspondence on variations was occasionally slow.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2020-10-29. All minor
observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the
inspecting authority.
6. RECOMMENDATION
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the
joint measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend
release of the balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability
period. Certified by T. Venkatesh, Project Director.
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on
satisfactory completion of the final inspection.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does not absolve the contractor
of any obligations under the contract, including the defect liability period.
